description: Runtime contract of the edge Worker. scripts/build-site.js publishes it in openapi.json, llms.txt, the MCP manifest, and the API index; edge/src reads it at runtime, so the docs and the behavior cannot drift.

invalid_json.title: Request body is not valid JSON
invalid_json.hint: Send one JSON object with Content-Type: application/json.

invalid_input.title: Input does not match the tool's input schema
invalid_input.hint: Compare the errors array with the tool's inputSchema in /openapi.json or /.well-known/mcp.json, fix the named fields, and retry.

unsupported_protocol_version.title: Unsupported MCP protocol version
unsupported_protocol_version.hint: Send an MCP-Protocol-Version header with a supported version (see supported_versions), or omit it.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.hint: List valid documents at /api/v1/index.json, course ids at /api/v1/courses.json, and every page at /sitemap.xml. Agent overview: /llms.txt.

unknown_tool.title: Unknown tool
unknown_tool.hint: Valid tool names are listed in /.well-known/mcp.json and under /api/v1/tools/ in /openapi.json.

method_not_allowed.title: Method not allowed
method_not_allowed.hint: See the Allow header. JSON documents and pages are GET-only; /mcp takes POST; tools take POST (or GET with query parameters).

unsupported_media_type.title: Unsupported media type
unsupported_media_type.hint: Send the request body as application/json.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.hint: Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After, then retry. Cache documents: they change a few times a week at most.

internal_error.title: Internal error
internal_error.hint: Retry once. If it keeps failing, email info@hazwoper-osha.com with the request path and time.

upstream_error.title: Upstream error
upstream_error.hint: The static origin did not answer. Retry with exponential backoff.
